name: Plaza Sendero Mexicali
summary: Plaza Sendero Mexicali is a popular regional shopping center on Boulevard Lázaro Cárdenas, part of Mexico's 22-location Sendero network. The mall offers comprehensive shopping, dining, and entertainment options including a movie theater, making it a favorite destination for families and friends throughout the Mexicali area.
demographics: Plaza Sendero Mexicali attracts a diverse middle-class demographic from the Mexicali metropolitan area, with a strong representation of families and young professionals aged 25-45. The trade area serves a growing border city population with household incomes ranging from moderate to upper-middle class, many of whom work in manufacturing, agriculture, and cross-border commerce. Shoppers typically seek value-oriented retail combined with entertainment options, making regular visits for both necessity shopping and leisure activities. The center draws from both local residents and visitors from the surrounding Baja California region who appreciate the convenience of having multiple shopping, dining, and entertainment options under one roof.
description: Plaza Sendero Mexicali is part of the prestigious Sendero shopping center network, which operates 22 locations throughout Mexico and continues expanding across the country. Located on Boulevard Lázaro Cárdenas in Mexicali, Baja California, this regional shopping destination offers visitors a comprehensive retail and entertainment experience. The center invites guests to enjoy a wide variety of activities including grocery shopping, catching the latest movies, discovering the newest fashion trends, dining at diverse restaurants, or simply strolling through the mall for leisure. Whether visiting with friends or family, Plaza Sendero Mexicali provides the perfect setting for a complete day out. With its strong 4.5-star rating from nearly 8,000 reviews, the center has established itself as a beloved community gathering place in Mexicali, offering both local residents and visitors from across the region a welcoming environment to shop, dine, and be entertained.
